name: Iron Heelbone
description: Throw the lead fist in a short straight line that arrives before the opponent's guard is set.

name: Shinruin
description: Follow the lead fist at once with the rear fist so both land within a single breath.

name: Invincible Hip
description: Raise lead and rear forearms together as a paired screen that turns a blow from either side.

name: Gust Clinch
description: Curve the approach to the opponent's flank like a river round a rock and strike from the side.

name: Grievous Palm
description: Sink into the hips and drive a looping fist to the ribs with the whole frame behind it.

name: Unsparing Shin
description: Gather qi at the shoulder for a beat and plunge the jab downward onto a lowered guard.

name: Tempered Sweep
description: Send both fists up beneath the guard one after the other, the second finishing what the first opened.

name: Massive Elbow
description: Fire the lead fist to open the guard and send the rear fist through the gap with qi concentrated at the knuckles.

name: Confluent Throw
description: Throw a four-fist run in which the second pair answers each guard the first pair provoked.

name: Nova Knuckle
description: Gather qi in the rear fist and release a single straight punch that bypasses a field-wrapped guard and shatters the target's ribs.

name: Gyvesweep
description: Seat the opponent in the frame of both arms and hold them inside it.

name: Unseen Shoulder
description: Slide along the opponent's side in one long step and take the near arm.

name: Rumble Knuckle
description: Drag the near arm and hook the far leg together to put the opponent on the floor.

name: Gyve Fist
description: Settle on the opponent's chest and let the weight sink as silt in the basin.

name: Thorn Hip
description: Lock both elbows across the body so neither arm can strike or guard.

name: Toxin Chokehold
description: Turn the opponent's pull into a throw that carries them past the hip.

name: Webbing Pinfall
description: Climb onto the opponent's back with hooks in and the head tucked tight.

name: Palmspine
description: Squeeze the ribcage in the locked frame until breath and qi cannot circulate fully.

name: Unseen Pinfall
description: Burst out of a hold with a surge of qi and come free at the opponent's side.

name: Throwvalor
description: Fix the joint lock and press the qi point at the neck so the opponent's cultivation stills while they are held.

name: Blaze Ulna
description: Fall on the opponent with a lowered elbow from above the shoulder line.

name: Obdurate Shin
description: Sweep an arm high and wide to turn aside a blow like a wing beating off a rival.

name: Punishing Grapple
description: Hook the fingers and rake across the face or throat.

name: Nimbuship
description: Spring upward and back from a close attack and land at the edge of reach.

name: Sweep Devastation
description: Leap forward from the crouch and drive a knee into the chest.

name: Sharp Knee
description: Mark the opponent's first twitch from above and answer it before the blow is begun.

name: Might Ulna
description: Lift the leg high with qi at the heel and drop it onto the collarbone.

name: Synchronized Knee
description: Beat a guard aside with one arm and strike through the opening with the other.

name: Nimbus Palm
description: Rise on a stored breath of qi and fall on the opponent so the whole weight and qi arrive at a single fingertip.

name: Hiphavoc
description: Open with two jabs thrown in one stride to find the range and shake the guard.

name: Blaze Elbow
description: Hook left and right to the head and ribs in a matched pair.

name: Unrelenting Fist
description: Shift the guard so each arm covers the line the other has left open.

name: Might Shoulder
description: Throw a low and a high kick from the same hip turn to split the guard in two heights.

name: Aura Throw
description: Weave left and right in a small pattern so no blow finds the same place twice.

name: Blaze Throw
description: Enter with both palms to the chest and press apart the arms in the guard.

name: Vengeful Clinch
description: Keep a double beat of strikes, the second timed to land as the first is parried.

name: Multiplying Hip
description: Throw four punches in a rolling order that each follow the line the last one opened.

name: Devastating Fist
description: Release two surges of qi, one through each fist, so the second passes through where the first made a gap.

name: Hoursweep
description: Gather qi for a long breath and unleash a six-strike set whose last blow lands on the first one's point.

name: Nimbus Chokehold
description: Chain three light strikes in a single stream so none breaks the rhythm.

name: Charter Shoulder
description: Plant the feet and let the guard stand like a stone as a stream parts around it.

name: Nimbussweep
description: Pull back low and away from an attack as if drawn out by a current.

name: Decimating Palm
description: Spin and throw the elbow behind to a grip taken from the rear.

name: Iron Knuckle
description: Release the rear fist in a torrent across the opponent's guard.

name: Aura Elbow
description: Drive the shoulder into the opponent's hips to break their stance like a bank washed away.

name: Flintlike Ulna
description: Gather qi in a deep pool at the center to harden the body against the strikes that follow.

name: Escalating Grapple
description: Throw two circular strikes in a spinning pair that draw the guard around and open the center.

name: Glint Heelbone
description: Gather qi in the paired fists so that both meet at one point on the chest and drive the qi through the bone.

name: Nimbuselbow
description: Lock wrist and elbow at once so that freeing one only tightens the other.

name: Fistmettle
description: Change from an arm hold to a leg hold in a single motion.

name: Thornknee
description: Bend the wrist in a small circle that rolls the arm and takes the elbow with it.

name: Elbowflash
description: Pivot on both feet in turn to keep the opponent locked as they spin.

name: Impenetrable Ulna
description: Check the opponent's hip with a knee to stop their entry into the lock.

name: Grapple Nerve
description: Pin the opponent's upper arm and thigh together under two knees.

name: Blaze Knee
description: Release the lock for one beat and strike the opened ribs before taking the hold again.

name: Rumble Pinfall
description: Turn the opponent's attempt to escape one hold into the entry for the other.

name: Nimbus Knuckle
description: Hold both joints and release a sharp surge of qi through the locks into the bones.

name: Nimbusulna
description: Hold two qi points together with the locks until the opponent's qi sinks and their strength drains away.

name: Shinmettle
description: Seal the opponent's qi flow through the locked arms until they have no way left to resist.

name: Granite Shin
description: Pull the opponent's sleeve and step in so their balance tips forward.

name: Toxin Knee
description: Drive the hip under the opponent and throw them over it in a high arc.

name: Sweep Nerve
description: Sweep both feet as the opponent's weight leaves the ground.

name: Maiming Chokehold
description: Seize both arms and drop under them to throw the opponent past the shoulder.

name: Unconquered Hip
description: Land from a throw's counter on both feet with the arms spread and the stance wide.

name: Immobilizing Heelbone
description: Press the thrown opponent into the ground with the weight of the following knee.

name: Aura Sweep
description: Spin the opponent in a full turn before releasing them so they land far off.

name: Facet Heelbone
description: Turn an incoming throw round on its own force so the thrower is the one who falls.

name: Tempered Shin
description: Lift the opponent to the peak of the arc and drive qi through them as they strike the ground.

name: Hogtying Palm
description: Seize the wrist with the hawk hand and draw the arm out straight.

name: Punishing Pinfall
description: Strike with one palm and follow with the second on the same line.

name: Heelbone Mettle
description: Cup both hands before the chest to take a blow and spread its force.

name: Evergreen Hip
description: Parry with an open palm that glides along the arm and strikes in return.

name: Ghosting Chokehold
description: Slide the rear foot to the lead and step again in one flowing line.

name: Shinscourge
description: Pull the opponent forward by the hawk grip and meet them with the palm.

name: Ulnawrath
description: Hold a palm on the chest and the hawk hand on the wrist and pour qi between the two.

name: Lothip
description: Grip, pull, strike and release in order to carry the opponent through four stations.

name: Obdurate Elbow
description: Meet a strike with the open palm and return its force along the same line into the attacker.

name: Ghosting Grapple
description: Burst out of reach in a flash of qi and return with both palms on the opponent's ribs.

name: Granite Shoulder
description: Set the feet on one line and the hands before the chest to begin every exchange from the same ground.

name: Gustelbow
description: Throw the fist along the bearing the stance has fixed and keep it true to the target.

name: Gust Knee
description: Slip the forearm along an incoming arm and let the blow pass into the air.

name: Gust Palm
description: Step forward to the very edge of the opponent's reach and stop.

name: Pitiless Throw
description: Strike with the elbow from the oath stance when the opponent crosses the line.

name: Gyvethrow
description: Root the legs with qi and hold the opponent's arm without being moved.

name: Might Knuckle
description: Meet a straight punch with a crossing fist that arrives first by a hair.

name: Berserk Shoulder
description: Send the fist through the opponent's guard with qi gathered at the knuckles and no wasted motion.

name: Intent Ulna
description: Throw a four-strike run along one bearing, each strike backed by a deeper breath.

name: Shinhavoc
description: Hold a full breath of qi in the stance and release it in a single fist that no guard can stand against.

name: Unsparing Elbow
description: Throw a quick lead punch off the stride like the first gust of a rising wind.

name: Devastating Throw
description: Follow the lead with a longer cross that carries the full force of the forward step.

name: Unassailable Fist
description: Hold the guard on a steady bearing and let the blows strike against it.

name: Kneevortex
description: Run flat-footed in a straight line toward the opponent along the bearing.

name: Fist Devastation
description: Swing a hook round the open side into the ribs with the wind at the back.

name: Aura Grapple
description: Drive the uppercut up from the knee as if a gust had caught it.

name: Grievous Throw
description: Hold the stride and throw fists in a steady storm that grows in weight with each one.

name: Novaknee
description: Fire a fist through a covered guard with a surge of qi that parts it like a gust through reeds.

name: Aura Chokehold
description: Run lead, cross, hook and uppercut in one breath, each blow quicker than the last.

name: Rampaging Iron Pinfall
description: Gather qi over a held breath and release one stride and one fist that lands as the full force of the gale.

name: Obdurate Knuckle
description: Set a wide base with the weight low as on a ledge with a drop behind.

name: Hoarfrost Elbow
description: Take the sleeve and keep the pull along one line so the opponent cannot slip it.

name: Harnessing Shin
description: Drag the opponent forward and down toward the edge in one pull.

name: Mayhempalm
description: Reap the standing leg with a short sharp sweep of the foot.

name: Enthralling Pinfall
description: Pin the opponent along a straight line and keep their shoulders flat.

name: Torrent Ulna
description: Roll over the shoulder and out of a hold in the direction the wind is blowing.

name: Sweep Tenacity
description: Throw the opponent to the lip of the ground and let their own balance carry them over.

name: Shadeelbow
description: Settle onto the opponent and hold with a promise of immovable weight until they tire.

name: Hoarfrost Clinch
description: Lock the arm across the knee and lean on it as a gust leans on a post.

name: Enthralling Clinch
description: Bind the arm and the qi point at the shoulder so the opponent's strength fails at once.

name: Iron Shin
description: Count the breath through the opening exchange and keep the guard on its bearing.

name: Lightning Shoulder
description: Check the footing on the bearing after each exchange so the base is never lost.

name: Hip Devastation
description: Press a palm forward slowly and release the breath at the point of contact.

name: Indomitable Heelbone
description: Hold the breath for one beat as a blow lands and tighten the whole body round it.

name: Blaze Knuckle
description: Return the fist in a straight line and keep the breath even as it comes back.

name: Meteoric Fist
description: Back off a half step on the out-breath to restore the distance.

name: Granite Elbow
description: Draw a long breath into the lower belly to build a reserve of qi for a prolonged fight.

name: Gnashing Hip
description: Send the breath out through the fist along the bearing and into the target.

name: Intent Grapple
description: Strike on the out-breath, recover on the in-breath and strike again without losing the bearing.

name: Glamour Fist
description: Hold the breath until the opponent strikes and return the blow along the bearing with all of its force.

name: Aurashin
description: Draw the sleeve and the arm across the body to start the throw.

name: Mayhemshin
description: Pivot the hip under the opponent and throw them in the direction of the wind.

name: Nimbus Pinfall
description: Reap the leg that carries the weight in a low sweeping arc.

name: Enthralling Heelbone
description: Dip under the arm and heave the opponent over the shoulder on a rising gust of qi.

name: Adamantine Shin
description: Land the counter-throw with the legs wide and the arms tucked, steady as on a plateau.

name: Throwblink
description: Step beside the opponent's drift and move with it before turning them.

name: Toxinclinch
description: Keep a hold on the sleeve through the whole throw and place the opponent at the end of the line.

name: Kneewrath
description: Spin with the opponent held and drive them down with the hip and shoulder in the same turn.

name: Aura Palm
description: Turn a throw against you into your own so the opponent falls on the line they began.

name: Immobilizing Toxin Shoulder
description: Gather qi, lift the opponent clear of the ground and release them so they land far from the thrower.

name: Elbowvortex
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot to face the opponent's new line across open ground.

name: Hipglare
description: Circle the opponent at the edge of reach to keep the wind at their face.

name: Ghosting Palm
description: Slide into the dead angle behind the opponent's lead shoulder.

name: Mightpalm
description: Jab at the full reach of the arm and step back before the counter.

name: Indomitable Ulna
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's attack and slip it by a half step.

name: Nimbus Grapple
description: Retreat in long even steps along a straight line without losing the guard.

name: Blaze Clinch
description: Enter on a quick low kick that lands before the opponent's own foot is set.

name: Sweepruin
description: Pursue a retreating opponent in a steady run that adds weight and qi to every punch.

name: Unseen Chokehold Whirlpool
description: Move across the open ground in one flash of qi and strike from the opponent's blind side.

name: Inexorable Shoulder
description: Hold the stance at a fixed distance and let no blow within it pass.

name: Clinch Scourge
description: Place a palm firmly on the opponent's chest to say plainly that the exchange has begun.

name: Chime Knee
description: Break the force of a blow with a forearm angled to the wind.

name: Silt Elbow
description: Step forward with the whole body and set the feet before the opponent can reset.

name: Decimating Throw
description: Throw the elbow along the bearing and hold it there until the blow lands.

name: Hipscourge
description: Slip a straight punch and answer with a long hook on the same line.

name: Throw Mettle
description: Fix the opponent's arm under the armpit and hold it as a vow once made.

name: Confluent Grapple
description: Rush the opponent in a run of strike, grab and throw without breaking stride.

name: Vengeful Knee
description: Send a straight blow through the guard in a single gust of qi, ending the exchange there.

name: Psychepalm
description: Gather qi over a long held breath and send a blow that reaches the body whatever the guard.

name: Hip Insight
description: Read the opponent's line of strike with a single glance at the shoulder and hip.

name: Torrent Fist
description: Parry along the bearing and answer on the same line with a fist.

name: Mightthrow
description: Slip to the outside of a straight blow and strike the exposed flank.

name: Unconquered Ulna
description: Block with the forearm and shove the opponent back along the bearing.

name: Toxinelbow
description: Catch a punching arm and turn it into a throw in the same gust.

name: Auraknee
description: Strike from the outside of the opponent's reach on the bearing opposite their blow.

name: Blaze Pinfall
description: Wait for the opponent's strike and return a cross with the whole force of the stride behind it.

name: Clinchhavoc
description: Turn the opponent's attack aside and send qi through the guard before they recover.

name: Unconquered Verity Shin
description: Take the full force of the opponent's blow into the stance and send it back along its bearing.
